name: TC-BUT-04: page heading and used-truck listing are visible on Buy Used Trucks
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/BuyUsedTrucks.cy.js#UsedTruck - BuyUsedTrucks [en] — Buy Used Trucks TC-BUT-04: page heading and used-truck listing are visible on Buy Used Trucks
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BUT-04
**Title:** page heading and used-truck listing are visible on Buy Used Trucks
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open Buy Used Trucks and confirm the page heading, the used-truck count, and at least one Contact Seller card.

**Expected Result:**
Used Trucks heading, a “N Used Truck Found” count, and at least one Contact Seller button are visible.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Buy Used Trucks page
2. Verify the page heading
3. Verify the listing count and a truck card
